source.article: Xian et al. (2025). Minimizing detection bias of somatic mutations in a highly heterozygous oak genome.

selection.roster: All ten previously amplicon-validated upper-branch SNVs that Xian et al. compared in the Napoleon Oak, from Schmid-Siegert et al. (2017).
selection.pairing: Within each ten-row block, use the tuple of values in column A (prior-assembly SNV) and column B (name) as the record key. All three blocks contain the same ten unique keys.
selection.flag: The legend at A2 designates orange as detected. Read the fill on column B for one detection indicator per prior record and method. Both zero-color and orange cells can contain a record name.
selection.method_labels: A4, A17 and A29 introduce the combination approach, haploid-assembly Strelka2 and diploid-assembly Strelka2. A17 spells the caller 'Strelke2'. The article gives its standard name.
selection.scope: Counts measure recovery on this selected positive roster from one oak. No reference-negative or TMD route labels were supplied for these comparisons.

reproduction.workbook_alternative: The same command accepts the original extracted Supplementary_Tables_G3-2025-405931.xlsx in place of the ZIP.
